comment: Exceptions for scripts/check-dist.mjs. Counts are exact: any change fails the check and must be reviewed. Every entry needs a reason.

innerHTML.reason: Preact core: the dangerouslySetInnerHTML code path (compare and assign). Reachable only through that prop, which ESLint forbids in our code (no-restricted-syntax).

console.reason: @standardnotes/component-relay Logger: console.log.bind is returned only when debug is true (the adapter passes debug: false); console.error is used once with a static string for unparsable messages, which the adapter guard rejects before the library sees them.

http://www.w3.org/2000/svg.reason: Preact: SVG namespace URI string for createElementNS; not a request.

http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML.reason: Preact: MathML namespace URI string for createElementNS; not a request.

http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml.reason: Preact: XHTML namespace URI string; not a request.

https://github.com/uuidjs/uuid#getrandom.reason: uuid (bundled inside component-relay): text of an Error thrown when crypto.getRandomValues is missing; not a request.
